fixesOpened.title: Stop the clip stream fallback retry loop on bad networks
fixesOpened.reporter: PostHog · “Edge function loop” alert firing (217/hr) · ~1,265 failed retries since yesterday 9 AM PT · build 39, mostly 2 phones on cellular
fixesOpened.whatItFixes: On bad cellular, the app kept re-asking our server for a video link in a loop for hours. One phone hit ~794 failed retries in a single evening (Oct 15, 5:05–10:54 PM PT), a second ~370 this morning, and PostHog's “Edge function loop” alert fired at 217 an hour. The fix makes the app back off after a failure instead of retrying right away, and recover on its own when the network comes back.
fixesOpened.howToCheck: On cellular or weak signal, leave a friend's clip that hasn't finished loading on screen. Turn airplane mode on for a minute, then off: within a few seconds the clip should play without force-quitting. Scrolling the post away and back should also retry.

whatIDidToday.note: Launched 1 Cloud Agent for the video-link retry loop behind PostHog's firing “Edge function loop” alert. PR: #523.

bugs.detail: media_invoke_retry_exhausted ~1,330 since Oct 15 9 AM PT; ~1,265 from clip_stream_fallback (playback_batch, 3 attempts), build 39 only. Two phones on cellular: 794 (Oct 15 5:05–10:54 PM PT, while recording a session) and 370 (Oct 16 6:28–8:09 AM PT); next 60 and 18. None had these the day before. Peak 288/hr at 10 PM PT.
